description:
Export Propensity = Exports / Production, annual: the share of EU
production that is exported. Not clamped -- values above 100% are
legitimate (re-exports, stock drawdown, scope differences). Returns the
export-propensity matrix, a sibling/per-code comparison, resolved
PRODCOM codes and availability notes.

compact.description: If true, condense long numeric time series (more than ~6 points -- typically monthly/quarterly windows or wide multi-partner/multi-period breakdowns) into summary statistics (first, last, min, max, mean, pct_change) instead of returning every data point. Leave false for full-fidelity series (e.g. to actually plot a chart); set true when you just need the headline trend and want to save context.

query.description: The customs-code/reporter/partner-set/period/frequency slice to query -- the same request body every tradedashboard.eu analytical endpoint takes. See its own field descriptions (customs_code, baskets, reporter, partner_set, period_start, period_end, frequency, n_top, ...) for details; exactly one of `customs_code` and `baskets` is required, everything else has a sensible default.

items.description: A nonempty tuple of pieces summed into one displayed line.

label.description: The basket's display label; default: the pieces' codes joined with '+'.

pieces.description: The pieces summed into this basket.

items.description: Every declaration under one code in one optional month window.

customs_code.description: The customs code: 2/4/6/8 digits, 'TOTAL', or a residual spelling (850440XX, 85SSS999, 85SSS).

anyOf.description: A calendar month, 'YYYY-MM'.

from_month.description: Inclusive first month of the window, ISO 'YYYY-MM'; null = the request's period_start.

anyOf.description: A calendar month, 'YYYY-MM'.

to_month.description: Inclusive last month of the window, ISO 'YYYY-MM'; null = the request's period_end.

baskets.description: The explicit basket form of the customs-code selection: a list of baskets, each a list of (customs_code, optional month window) pieces summed into one displayed line. Use it to clip a code to specific months or to chain successor codes (e.g. [{pieces: [{customs_code: '8524', to_month: '2006-12'}, {customs_code: '85241100', from_month: '2007-01'}]}] with a period starting before 2007). Every piece must meet the requested period. Exactly one of 'customs_code' and 'baskets' must be given.

anyOf.description: A canonical customs code, TOTAL, or a supported residual spelling.

items.description: A canonical customs code, TOTAL, or a supported residual spelling.

customs_code.description: Combined Nomenclature customs code(s), 2–8 digits, or the literal 'TOTAL' meta-aggregate (all products combined). Residual customs codes are requestable too (e.g. 850440XX, 85SSS999, 85SSS); see https://tradedashboard.eu/faq-en.html#customscode for details. Pass a list to compare codes side by side, or to aggregate them in views that fold several codes into one basket: their volumes are summed and prices volume-weighted across every tab — except the Cross-section views, which keep each code separate. Exactly one of 'customs_code' and 'baskets' must be given.

frequency.description: Resampling frequency for the series: 'month', 'quarter' or 'year'.

group_reporters.description: Explicit reporters for a custom reporter group. Each entry must be an EU Member State, EU candidate country, or Northern Ireland. When more than one is supplied the frame is aggregated into a synthetic group named after 'reporter'.

include_other.description: Bundle entities outside the top-N into a single 'Other' bucket.

include_residuals.description: Include the residual customs-code layer: residual rows in the breakdown views (subcode-compare, concentration-compare, volatility heatmap), the residual share in the response header and the related notes. False hides all of it; non-residual figures are unaffected.

lang.description: Language for translated labels in the response: one of the listed ones (the languages the metadata exists in); any other is refused.

n_top.description: Number of top entities (by volume/value) to break out individually in charts.

partner_set.description: Named partner preset, e.g. 'non-EU countries', 'EU countries', 'all countries', or a predefined partner group.

partners.description: Explicit partner-country list that overrides 'partner_set' when present.

period_end.description: Inclusive end of the analysis window, ISO month 'YYYY-MM'. Defaults to roughly three months ago — the latest period Eurostat typically has fully reported.

period_start.description: Inclusive start of the analysis window, ISO month 'YYYY-MM'.

remove_outliers.description: Drop extreme unit-price outliers before computing weighted-average prices.

reporter.description: Declaring entity: an EU Member State, an EU candidate country, Northern Ireland ('XI'), or one of the three aggregate presets ('European Union', 'Euro area', 'EU candidate countries'), or a predefined reporter group name.

name: get_export_propensity

anyOf.description:
POST /api/vulnerability/{net-import-reliance,trade-intensity,
export-propensity} — one shared shape; ``indicator`` says which.

comparison.description: The indicator figures: one code against its PRODCOM siblings ('single'), or the entered codes side by side ('multi').

oneOf.description:
Single-code mode: the code's own indicator matrix, compared with its
same-level PRODCOM siblings (never the parent or sub-categories, so every
series is directly comparable).

aggregable.description: Whether the resolved PRODCOM codes sit at one hierarchy level, so that data sums them; false forces an explicit pick.

additionalProperties.description:
One (measure, basis) trade-exposure result -- the wire mirror of
``IndicatorComponentStatus``: the ratio line (``indicator``), the inputs
it was built from (``components``) and the per-period status.  Empty (no
periods) when the indicator has no data.

components.description: {input: period-aligned component series the indicator is built from}.

data_status.description: The per-period availability/gap/reliability verdicts and component statuses (empty arrays when the indicator has no data).

availability.description: Per period: why the figure is null when a component is not usable; null = every component usable.

anyOf.description:
The state of one PRODCOM code's cell.

``not_available`` and ``different_unit`` are assigned by aggregation and
are never stored. Arithmetic reads the explicit properties below, not the
declaration order: this is not a general severity ladder.

The status of one total over every selected PRODCOM code.

The figure is usable exactly when no code blocks it and at least one code
is usable. ``codes`` retains the reason for every non-exact contribution.

band.description: Half-width of the rounding interval in this component's unit.

band_unknown.description: A rounded contribution has no usable base, so the band is unknown.

items.description: A dotted PRODCOM code.

codes.description: The selected codes under every state other than exact.

propertyNames.description:

declaration order: this is not a general severity ladder.

flag.description: Headline: the main caveat of a usable total, else the main reason it is null.

items.description: A dotted PRODCOM code.

units.description: For different_unit: selected codes grouped by their recorded unit.

components.description: {component: per-period status, selected-code reasons and rounding band in that component's unit}.

propertyNames.description:
The DS-059358 indicators carried through every reshaped PRODCOM
frame: one per *source* (a production basis, or a trade flow) and
*measure*. Production is total sold production alongside its two
2021-onward components (own account ``OWN*``, sub-contracted ``SC*``);
imports/exports have no own/sub split and share the production QNTUNIT.
PRODVAL is NOT assumed to equal own + sub (the series are reported and
suppressed independently).

The declaration order is the frame's column order: every value
indicator, then every quantity one.

gap.description: Per period: why the figure is null although every component is usable (a formula gap).

anyOf.description:
Why an indicator is not computable although every component cell is
present: the formula-gap labels of a PRODCOM data status.

reliability.description: Per period, on a numeric figure only: its main caveat. On an EU27 figure an estimate means the total includes national estimates.

anyOf.description:
The state of one PRODCOM code's cell.

``not_available`` and ``different_unit`` are assigned by aggregation and
are never stored. Arithmetic reads the explicit properties below, not the
declaration order: this is not a general severity ladder.

indicator.description: The period-aligned indicator line; null = availability gap (see data_status).

periods.description: The block's period axis (first day of each period); every array in this block is parallel to it.

propertyNames.description:
The production basis axis: total sold production and its two
2021-onward components, own-account and sub-contracted.

data.description: The selected (or summed) codes' measure × basis indicator matrix; empty when unavailable.

propertyNames.description:
The measure an indicator, a ranking or a volatility measure is taken over:
the value, the quantity, or the price per unit (volatility only).

prodcom.description: How the customs code resolved to PRODCOM: the code picker, fallback and unit notes, the unavailability reason and the quantity-unit periods.

notes.description: Fallback, selection and quantity-unit notes explaining the resolution.

prodcom_codes.description: The resolved PRODCOM code picker (deduplicated, data-bearing mappings); empty in multi-code mode, where each comparison entry carries its own.

items.description:
One distinct data-bearing PRODCOM code of the code picker

collapse onto the same aggregate appear once.

original_prodcom_code_fmt.description: The mapped dotted forms that fell back to this code (comma-joined); None for exact codes.

prodcom_code.description: The data-bearing PRODCOM code, in dotted form on the wire.

status.description: 'exact' when the data-bearing code is a mapped code's own level, 'fallback' otherwise.

quantity_units.description: Quantity and unit-value units, period by period. Figures in spans with different recorded units are not comparable; mixed spans have no quantity total.

items.description: Consecutive years whose quantities and unit values share one unit state.

first.description: First year of the span (first day of the year).

mixed.description: The published quantity units involved when mixed; empty otherwise.

label.description: The unit's display label in the response's language.

residual.description: True for the synthetic level of a residual spelling.

segment.description: True for a historical segment's own definition.

customs_code.description: A canonical customs code, TOTAL, or a supported residual spelling.

siblings.description: For a catch-all level, the ordinary siblings it excludes.

text.description: The level's label, in the requested language.

untranslated.description: True when the label fell back to English.

anyOf.description: The validity window of one customs-code segment (one definition).

valid_from.description: First day of the window, ISO date.

valid_to.description: Last day of the window, ISO date; null while in force.

window.description: For a level read from a dated edition (a former definition, or one of its ancestors as that edition had them): the validity window of the definition shown. Absent for current-edition levels.

indicator.description: Which of the three EU27 trade-exposure indicators this payload carries.
